alt: Chart with concentric rings of black, blue, yellow, beige, and red. Arrows with dollar amounts note the increase from 5.3 million in the year 1875 to 13.4 milion in 1899.

alt: Map of Georgia with different colors for each county and annotations that indicate the number of acres of land owned in each county.
title: "Land owned by Negroes in Georgia, U.S.A. 1870-1900."
